new_value: Already landed on main (worker-7, part 1 of the bead). lichen/tests/coap_backoff/ (CMakeLists.txt + main.c following tests/cmake/test_common.cmake) is a committed host test covering exactly the bead's part-(1) matrix: canonical duty payload {reason,retry_after,level}, BOTH key orders (PAYLOAD_RETRY_FIRST), short form (uint 5) and 2-byte 0x19 form (1000), the 3600 DoS cap (7200->3600), malformed payloads all falling back to 60 (non-map, bstr value, negative int, 4-byte 0x1A form, int key, empty map), and payload-absent/NULL -> 60. Also covers the arm/active/remaining state machine (until_ms, expiry edge, NULL safety). Built and ran locally on worker2: cmake -B build && cmake --build build && ctest -> 1/1 PASSED. Independent-oracle discipline is documented in the file header (fixtures hand-encoded per RFC 8949, expected durations mirror the Rust/Python reference clients, nothing derived from backoff.c). Part (2) — the optional shared cross-impl vector file — was marked OPTIONAL in the bead and is the only remaining piece; filing as a small follow-up rather than reopening this bead.
